stem: Quartz Media already chose c7g family and now needs the smallest size that safely handles 95th percentile CPU peaks above current large capacity.
rationale: Moving from large to xlarge is the next incremental size step and often the right first adjustment when current large capacity is exceeded. Staying on large leaves the known peak issue unresolved. Jumping to 8xlarge or metal introduces far more capacity and cost than the scenario indicates is necessary.
